name: Coil Cable Specialist, Inc.
old_description: 🚀 We've launched a new website! If you're a reseller and need your account updated, please contact us
about:
Coil Cable Specialist, Inc. operates from Gardena, California, where it has built a business around custom coil cable manufacturing. The company references more than ten years of experience in the field, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. Ownership structure and founder names have not been published.

The firm produces a range of coil cables and bulk cable made to customer specifications. Its catalog spans electronic, control, power, tower/hybrid, USB 2/3, audio, coaxial, test lead/grounding wire, ethernet, and trailer coil cables. Products are listed with detailed specifications such as conductor gauge, voltage rating, and jacket color, indicating a make-to-order capability alongside stocked standard parts.

The product lineup suggests service to electronics OEMs, industrial automation, power distribution, telecommunications, audio/video equipment, test and measurement, and automotive or trailer applications. The website also addresses resellers, indicating a distribution channel alongside direct sales.

The company states that on-time delivery and affordable high-end quality that exceeds expectations are the qualities distinguishing it from competitors. It aims to forge long-lasting relationships by applying its decade-plus of experience to each order.
